baseline_prompt_en: An unmistakably adult bookish woman in her mid-twenties stands with her back against the sun-warmed white wall of a beachside pavilion, holding a weathered paperback against her chest. An unmistakably adult athletic blond man in his late twenties, deeply suntanned and dressed in an open coral resort shirt over a white tank, plants one palm on the wall beside her head and leans into a confident one-arm wall pin, directing the gesture toward her. The scene reads as a charged beachside confrontation between contrasting adult personalities. His cocky half-smile slips into a briefly intent, unmistakably attracted gaze as the paperback tilts between them. He keeps his braced hand beside the same woman; her startled composure cracks into a flushed, involuntary glance toward him, and the paperback lowers slightly between them. The frame catches this already-visible consequence in one moment, with turquoise surf, beach grass, and low golden sunlight behind them. Cinematic editorial photography, natural skin texture, crisp relational body language, intimate medium shot, shallow depth of field.
